title: Sompo completes buyout of Shriram General Insurance
body: Japan's Sompo Holdings Inc has completed the acquisition of Shriram General Insurance Company Limited, purchasing the entire shareholding held by Shriram Capital Private Limited. Shriram Capital had owned 100% of the general insurer since it was carved out as a separate entity in 2019. The transaction closed on 5 March 2026, and Sompo now holds 100% of Shriram General Insurance.
